gbm_population_evidence.quote: Glioblastoma Multiforme; Brain Neoplasms; Gastroesophageal Adenocarcinoma; Pancreatic Ductal Adenocarcinoma
Patients with histologically or cytologically confirmed and documented r/r GBM that has progressed after prior radiation therapy and have not received prior bevacizumab

candidate_evidence.quote: Phase I, Open-label, Multicenter Study to Evaluate the Imaging Performance, Safety, Biodistribution and Dosimetry of [68Ga]-FF58 in Adult Patients With Selected Solid Tumors Expected to Overexpress αvβ3 and αvβ5 Integrins.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: r/r GBM that has progressed after prior radiation therapy

role_evidence.quote: to characterize the imaging properties, safety, biodistribution and dosimetry properties of \[68Ga\]-FF58

agents.drug_class_hint: gallium-68 labelled alphav-beta3/alphav-beta5 integrin-targeting PET imaging radioligand (FF58)

coder_notes: Early Phase 1 first-in-human PET imaging study; the only agent is a diagnostic radiotracer, so no pharmacological candidate. Basket of GBM, breast cancer brain metastases, GEA and PDAC. Integrin alphav-beta3/alphav-beta5 overexpression is 'expected', not an entry requirement, and is assessed by imaging only, so not recorded as a molecular biomarker. Dosimetry/PK (blood radioactivity, tumour absorbed dose) relates to the diagnostic agent, not a candidate; tumour_pk_planned coded no.
